markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (95%)** · Confident · Careful review
Tier 1 simulated surgical frozen section with a single-class conformal set [F1] and severity-3 resample degradation.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | Invasive 95%, InSitu 4%, Benign 1%, Normal 0% | Strong invasive probability score |
| Conformal set | {Invasive} (alpha 10%; test coverage 90%) | Single class at 90% guarantee |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% reliability, 100% OOD, 12/12 regions (AUROC 70%) [F6] | Atypical OOD, no quality flag |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Agree on top class | Independent backbones share top class |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Invasive (68%–81% similarity) [F5]; Benign contrast 65% | All nearest references match Invasive |

## Tissue evidence
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 2, 6, 11) · ↑ invasive · Unreliable score (+0.96 contribution [F2]); 0/20 AI spot check · Unreliable
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (regions 3, 7, 11) · ↑ invasive · Above-typical stromal infiltration (+0.81 contribution [F3]); 19/20 spot check · Validated
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (regions 1) · ↑ invasive · Unreliable low score (-0.27, +0.73 contribution [F4]); 0/20 spot check · Unreliable
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 8) · ↑ invasive · Below-typical benign stroma (-0.33, +0.58 contribution); 20/20 spot check · Validated
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (regions 6, 7, 11) · ↑ invasive · Above-typical nuclear atypia (+1.32, +0.14 contribution); 18/20 spot check · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; removing top 3 risk regions drops invasive probability above random (0.011, 95% CI 0.002–0.020, n=132).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (0.001, 95% CI -0.009–0.006 includes 0); relies on unreliable mitoses and normal-lobule scores (both 0/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Severity-3 resample degradation on this simulated frozen section mimics invasion or masks tubules (contrast Benign BACH_0284, 65% similarity).
- Clear margin call [F7] misses focal involvement; lateral margin reaches 100% (0.9969 vs 0.9998 threshold; inferior and superior 98%).

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 3, 6, 7, 11**: Confirm stromal invasion and pleomorphism directly; cell segmentation is disabled and stains are blocked.
2. **Regions 1, 7, 9**: Inspect lateral (0.9969 vs 0.9998 threshold), inferior (98%), and superior (98%) margins for involvement.
3. **Regions 1, 2, 5, 8**: Manually check mitoses and lobules (unreliable AI scores) plus low-risk regions (10%–44%).

found: The CONCH–MUSK row names Invasive, but agreement.conch_musk_same_top only says the two models agree with each other; the JSON does not say which class they chose.
OOD percentile 1 means this image is farther from the calibration images than 100% of them (atypical), not 'typical'.
